invariant.the_one_increase: I4_attribution_tie 119 -> 120. One row gained. A fix of this kind should add nothing anywhere, so this is a real if tiny violation and is recorded as such rather than rounded away. It needs identifying before C34 ships into a registration.
invariant.my_first_reading_was_wrong: I initially reported I1 and LS_capped_lethal_shape as RISING. That compared against the ARCHIVE's counts instead of the sweep's. Against the sweep both fall sharply -- I1 333 -> 96, LS_capped_lethal_shape 501 -> 461 -- which shows the leak was inflating four families at once, not only the structural one.

does_not_reach_a_pass: 515 unattributed rows remain against a required zero, and the C32 run independently failed on coverage 0.9587 against a 0.97 floor, on seven family bounds calibrated from the archive, and on eighteen malformed predicted_class entries. This fix touches none of those.
